project.title: Standardised Sample Handling and QC Upgrade in Core Lab
project.objective: Design and roll out a unified SOP and QC system for blood and biological samples to cut pre-analytical errors and ensure regulatory-compliant processing.
deliverables: End-to-end sample handling and labelling SOP for blood and tissue samples
Updated QC checklist for routine tests and equipment maintenance
Training package and competency checklist for lab staff
Environmental and waste handling addendum to existing procedures
Baseline and post-rollout error and rejection rate report
constraints: All new SOPs must comply with internal data protection and biosafety rules
No downtime of critical diagnostic analysers during rollout
Training must be completed in shifts to keep lab fully operational
Environmental and medical waste procedures must align with legislation
Documentation must be auditable and version-controlled

risks.risk: Staff resistance to new SOPs and checklists.
risks.mitigation: Involve technicians in drafting, run short pilots, and collect quick feedback before full rollout.

risks.risk: Inconsistent adoption across shifts leading to mixed practices.
risks.mitigation: Create mandatory competency checks per shift and monitor adherence via spot audits.

risks.risk: Regulatory non-compliance in environmental and waste handling updates.
risks.mitigation: Have environmental technician and compliance officer review and sign off all changes.

risks.risk: Data entry and labelling errors during transition period.
risks.mitigation: Introduce dual-check for labelling and temporary parallel run of old vs new forms for high-risk samples.

themes.why_relevant: Most lab errors occur before analysis; better handling and labelling reduce repeats and delays.
Different technicians and shifts currently follow slightly different routines, causing variability.
Consistent maintenance and QC logs are needed to support reliable test results and audits.
Proper disposal and environmental monitoring are mandatory and impact lab accreditation.
All staff must be trained and signed off on new procedures to ensure safe, consistent practice.

backlog.task: Map current sample collection, labelling, and reception workflows across all shifts
definition_of_done: Flowchart of current state for blood and biological samples is documented
Differences between shifts and teams are listed
Pain points and frequent error sources are identified and summarised

backlog.task: Draft unified SOP for blood sample handling from reception to storage
definition_of_done: SOP covers reception, identification, labelling, centrifugation, storage and retrieval
Includes PPE, biosafety and data protection requirements
Reviewed and accepted by laboratory manager and QA officer

backlog.task: Define QC checklist for routine blood testing and equipment maintenance
definition_of_done: Checklist includes daily, weekly and monthly QC tasks for key analysers
Acceptance criteria and corrective actions are clearly described
Checklist template is ready for printing and digital use

backlog.task: Create training slides and quick reference cards for new SOPs
definition_of_done: Slide deck explains rationale, key changes and step-by-step procedures
One-page quick reference cards are created for sample handling and QC
Materials are stored in shared drive and linked in channel

backlog.task: Update environmental monitoring and waste disposal procedures
definition_of_done: Procedures for sample waste, sharps and chemical disposal are documented
Environmental monitoring points and frequency are defined
Compliance officer has reviewed and approved the updates

backlog.task: Design competency checklist and sign-off process for technicians
definition_of_done: Checklist covers sample handling, QC steps and waste procedures
Sign-off criteria and responsible reviewers are defined
Template is shared and ready for use in training sessions

backlog.task: Pilot new SOP and QC checklist on one shift for one week
definition_of_done: Pilot shift is selected and informed
Feedback on clarity, workload and issues is collected from staff
List of required adjustments is documented

backlog.task: Implement standardised labelling scheme for all incoming samples
definition_of_done: Labelling rules for patient ID, date, time and test type are defined
Examples of correct and incorrect labels are documented
Reception staff confirm they can apply the scheme consistently

backlog.task: Set up error and rejection rate tracking for pre-analytical phase
definition_of_done: Data fields for tracking errors and rejections are defined
Simple log or sheet is created and shared
Baseline data for previous month is entered for comparison

backlog.task: Align bone marrow and stem cell sample handling with new SOP framework
definition_of_done: Specific steps for high-risk samples are documented
Cryopreservation and transport requirements are included
Consistency with general SOP is checked and confirmed

backlog.task: Create incident reporting template for sample handling and QC deviations
definition_of_done: Template captures type of deviation, root cause and corrective action
Process for logging and reviewing incidents is described
Template is accessible to all lab staff

backlog.task: Prepare final summary report on SOP rollout and early impact
definition_of_done: Report compares baseline and post-rollout error and rejection rates
Key lessons learned and remaining gaps are listed
Report is shared with laboratory manager and QA officer

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current workflows and confirm scope of SOP and QC upgrade.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to share how they currently handle sample reception and QC.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on which sample types and processes are in scope for the first SOP version.
Confirm which shift will be used as the pilot group for the new procedures.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and finalise the unified sample handling SOP draft.
threads_plan.trigger: Post link to the latest SOP draft and request targeted comments and approvals.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the core sample reception, labelling and storage steps in the SOP.
Decide on the standardised labelling scheme to be applied to all incoming samples.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock down QC checklist, competency checks and training approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Share QC checklist and competency checklist drafts and ask for feedback on feasibility.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final version of the routine QC and equipment maintenance checklist.
Agree on the minimum competency criteria and sign-off process for technicians.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and monitor the pilot rollout and incident reporting.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that the pilot shift will start using the new SOP and QC checklist.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot start and end dates and which metrics will be tracked.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Consolidate results, lessons learned and final rollout adjustments.
threads_plan.trigger: Post preliminary pilot results and ask for feedback and final tweaks before full rollout.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide on any final SOP and QC adjustments and agree on full lab rollout date.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in at shift change with quick update on SOP or QC issues.
Twice-weekly thread to log any incidents or near-misses using the deviation template.
Weekly summary post with updated error metrics and open action items.
Post-training recap message after each training block capturing questions and clarifications.
